note: The owner's 54 VIP-pass pandals, exactly as supplied. This file is the source of truth for VIP membership: the names here decide which pandals are VIP, and must not be swapped for more famous ones. 'slug' is the matching record in data/pandals.json. status: matched = identity is confident; review = the best available record, but the identity or the pin needs a human to confirm; missing = no record exists in the catalogue yet. scripts/build-data.mjs reads this file and sets isVIP on every matched/review slug. Phase 5 resolved every 'missing' entry (new records) and the couple rows that were stubs.
